messages:
Ana (Platform): Heads-up — I'm swapping out of primary early tonight. Flight ETA pushed so I need someone to cover the 22:30–23:15 UTC overlap window. There's a potential gap where our US evening handoff meets APAC morning. Noticed a small spike on token-processing-latency in the last 30m but nothing yet at pager thresholds. 

Matt (SRE): I can take primary from 22:15–23:45 UTC if Tina can shadow 22:15–22:45 then go secondary. That gives a 30m overlap for handoff. Is 22:15 okay? :thumbsup:

Tina (Oncall): 22:15 works for me. I'll be on video for the first 10 minutes to run through active alerts and kiosks. I'll also keep an eye on embeddings pipeline errors and rate limiter alerts.

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT LOG — paging.sentry: alert token-processing-latency breached warning threshold (p75 480ms). No pager escalation. Incident ID: INC-2026-5791. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-investigation 

Ana (Platform): Thanks — linking runbook here too: /runbooks/primary-coverage-overlap. In the runbook steps under "If spike but no pager" -> check prefix cache hit-rate, KV cache warming, and any recent model rollouts. I just rolled a small quantized variant at 21:40 but traffic was minimal.

Matt (SRE): Noted. I'll start with dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/token-latency and perf logs in k8s: namespace redwood-inference-prod. If I see sustained p95 > 800ms I'll escalate to Sev2 and wake the infra rotation.

Jason (Infra): FYI I have a standby GPU pool in us-west that can be bumped to dedicated if we see sustained token backlog. Ping me with "@Jason bump-pool" and I can trigger.

Tina (Oncall): Quick ask — can someone drop the exact handoff checklist in this thread? I'll walk through during the 22:15 shadow. I want to make sure the customer-impact lines are clear in case we need an incident bridge.

Ana (Platform): Handoff checklist (paste):
```
- Confirm active alerts (Cloudwatch/Sentry/Prometheus)
- Check model version pinned on route /v1/generate (model_id + checksum)
- Verify KV/prefix cache hit-rates and evictions
- Validate recent deploys in last 2h
- Note any ongoing Dedicated capacity changes or autoscale events
- Confirm backup routing policy and fallback model variant UX
- Contact list: Matt (SRE), Jason (Infra), Tina (Oncall), Eng-ops on-call
```

Matt (SRE): I'll post a quick summary at 22:30 for handoff: current p50/p95/p99, any open alerts, and actions taken. If it looks stable by 23:15 I'll keep primary until 23:45 per plan — otherwise we'll coordinate immediate swap.

Oncall Bot: SCHEDULE NOTE — Tina assigned secondary for 22:15–02:15 UTC. Matt assigned primary 22:15–23:45 UTC. Auto-reminder 15m before swap.

Tina (Oncall): A couple of practical notes from last night's swap: the prefix-cache debug endpoint can hang for ~10s during high mem pressure — prefer `curl -sS` with a 5s timeout. Also watch the dedupe queue metric `inflight-requests/deduper`.

Ana (Platform): Perfect. I'll DM any context on the 21:40 quantized rollout to Matt. Leaving the thread now — thanks all. :pray:

Matt (SRE): Thanks Ana — will keep notes and escalate if p95 > 800ms for 5m. Tina, see you at 22:15 for shadow. Jason, will call with "@Jason bump-pool" if backlog hits 15k tokens/min.

Jason (Infra): Got it. Standing by.

Tina (Oncall): Ready. See you in 30.

(END OF THREAD)
